verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a product-planning tool with customer-request tracking could plausibly ship a customer-facing changelog. However, the evidence shows no such Linear feature. The changelog citations are entries from Linear's own release notes, not a capability users can publish with. The customer-requests docs cover capturing and analyzing feedback, not announcing shipped work back to customers.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can publish a changelog announcing shipped features to close the loop with customers
